decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX rests directly on the firm's long-standing trommel screening know-how and an established customer base, so the firm can read market feedback and keep refining it.
Mobile flail shredding sits close to the firm's core mobile shredding competence, which lets it absorb field results and improve the line, even though nothing has been observed since 2019.

The stationary electric fine shredder is further from the mobile core and has had little visibility, but it builds plant-based knowledge in line with the firm's strategy, so the firm keeps it while it gains experience.

The green-waste grinder serves established composting and biomass customers using existing grinding knowledge, and after Product C was withdrawn it likely carries that know-how forward, though its limited visibility leaves some risk.
The single-shaft pre-shredders draw on core shredder expertise and support the stated expansion into stationary plants, so the firm is well placed to assimilate results and develop them.
